Anika (CEO): Thanks for joining the town hall today — rapid follow-up below with owners, clarifications, and a couple of small asks. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-briefing (org access).

Tom (Growth): Quick one: will we have a public one-pager for partners summarizing Dedicated vs Private differences? Some resellers asked for something short.

Hana (Solutions Eng): I can draft a one-pager. Suggest: 1) deployment modes matrix 2) typical latency/cost tradeoffs 3) support levels. Will post draft in #partnerships.

Eve (Research): From the roadmap q: timeline on model onboarding cadence? We asked about monthly curated model drops vs ad-hoc.

Devon (CTO): Plan: curated set every 6 weeks, with emergency onboarding for high-demand community models. We'll publish a calendar in Product Confluence.

Tom (Growth): Also asked if we can provide sample SLAs/metrics for partner demos (simple table with p50/p95/p99 targets). That helps sales decks.

Anika (CEO): Yes — we'll publish a partner-friendly SLA summary (non-binding for pilot). Dev + Product to own.

Hana (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll work with Priya to make a condensed tech sheet and a longer runbook for customers who need the nitty-gritty.

Eve (Research): For Optimize experiments: can we surface an "expected savings" calc in the Console using customers' token mix? That was a strong ask during Q&A.

Devon (CTO): Good idea. Product + Research to prototype a boilerplate estimator. Privacy note: estimator should run on aggregated stats client-side or via opt-in telemetry. Legal to confirm.

ops-bot: New event created: "AH follow-ups: partner assets + optimizer estimator" 2026-03-29 10:00 PST. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/1937012468

Anika (CEO): Action items consolidated below. Please add JIRA links when you create tasks. If you can't meet dates, flag by 2026-03-27 so we can re-prioritize.

Action items:
- Hana (Solutions Eng) -> draft partner one-pager + tech sheet; post draft in #partnerships by 2026-03-26
- Devon (CTO) -> publish model onboarding cadence to Confluence and confirm emergency onboarding flow by 2026-03-30
- Product (Priya) & Eve (Research) -> prototype Optimize "expected savings" estimator design doc; include privacy options (client-side vs opt-in telemetry) due 2026-04-05
- Tom (Growth) -> assemble partner SLA summary for sales decks (pilot-friendly) due 2026-03-28

Tom (Growth): I'll collect feedback from a couple of reseller partners and iterate quickly.

Eve (Research): For the estimator, I'll include a simple formula and example outputs so sales can demo easy wins.

Devon (CTO): I'll add a note about emergency model onboarding SLA (48-72h for critical models) into the Confluence page.

Anika (CEO): Thanks team. Small ask: ping this thread once you link the JIRAs so we can keep the action-trail tidy. :white_check_mark:
